title: Attention Is All You Need for Chinese Word Segmentation
answer_short: Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention captures localness and directional information by applying a Gaussian weight based on character distance and using multi-head attention to capture information from different subspaces.
answer_rationale: The Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention is a variant of scaled dot-product attention designed to capture localness and directional information. It applies a Gaussian weight based on the distance between characters (Text 8) and uses multi-head attention to capture information from different subspaces (Text 2, Text 5). It replaces standard self-attention in the Transformer encoder to enhance directional feature capture (Text 7, Text 9).
